SELECT od.OD_ID AS odId, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, po.OPTION_NAME AS optionName, od.PRICE_FIX AS priceFix, pi.PRODUCT_IMAGE_PATH AS productImagePath, pi.PRODUCT_IMAGE_SAVE_NAME AS productImageSaveName FROM ORDERDETAIL od JOIN PRODUCTORDER pord ON od.ORDER_ID = pord.ORDER_ID JOIN OPTIONDETAIL opd ON od.POP_ID = opd.POP_ID JOIN PRODUCT p ON opd.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID JOIN PRODUCTOPTION po ON opd.OPTION_ID = po.OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCTIMAGE pi ON pi.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID AND pi.PRODUCT_TITLE_IMAGE = 0 WHERE od.OD_ID = #{odId} AND pord.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEWLIKE rl WHERE rl.REVIEW_ID = r.REVIEW_ID) AS LIKE_COUNT, r.OD_ID, r.MEMBER_ID, pi.PRODUCT_IMAGE_PATH, pi.PRODUCT_IMAGE_SAVE_NAME FROM REVIEW r JOIN ORDERDETAIL orderd ON r.OD_ID = orderd.OD_ID JOIN OPTIONDETAIL od ON orderd.POP_ID = od.POP_ID JOIN PRODUCTOPTION po ON po.OPTION_ID = od.OPTION_ID JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_ID = od.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCTIMAGE pi ON pi.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID AND pi.PRODUCT_TITLE_IMAGE = 0 WHERE r.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND r.REVIEW_STATUS = 1 ORDER BY r.WRITE_DATE DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
